description: Using Tradetron you can now build a Trailing Stoploss on each leg of your strategy. In order to add this keyword follow the steps shared below:
how_to_use_markdown:
Using Tradetron you can now build a Trailing Stoploss on each leg of your strategy. In order to add this keyword follow the steps shared below:

Add the entry conditions and positions in your strategy

Search for keyword "leg TSL" in your Universal exit, repair once, set exit.

![Example](./images/img-1668774235.png)

Click on the keyword and select the name of the instrument and input the location of the same

![Example](./images/img-1668774273.png)

Select your TSL type:

TSL - Points will calculate all values in points. (not rupees)

TSL - Percentage will calculate all values in %

This is the start point of your TSL.

Example: If you bought a PUT at 100 and select 20 points in "activate at", the TSL will begin only when your PUT trades above 120.

This will exit your position if the price moves against you for more than the selected % or points from the activate at level.

Example: If your bought PUT's TSL is activated at 20 points the LTP begins to move below 110, "Lock profit at" will exit at 10 points or 10% in profit.

Now add your "Increase profit by"

This is the minimum move in your favour before which the TSL will be modified.

Now add your "Increase TSL by"

The TSL will move by the points or percentage indicated here.

Leg TSL / Leg Exit / Leg SL Trail — Usage Note

Use Leg TSL, Leg Exit, and Leg SL Trail only for legs that are intended to trade once. These features do not work correctly for re-entries. If you allow the same leg to enter again from the same position, the leg-exit logic may fail or cause the strategy to loop.

To prevent problems, make sure your logic includes a keyword or condition that blocks re-entry for that leg when using any of these set-exit keywords. In short: if a leg is meant to run only once, ensure it can’t re-enter from the same position — otherwise Leg Exit / Leg TSL / Leg SL Trail will not function as expected.

This is what your final condition will look like, no need to add comparators, just Leg TSL condition.

![Example](./images/img-1668774321.png)

Video on the topic:

https://youtu.be/M2PlEGXmSNc

parameters.name: Condition Type
parameters.description: Which block the target leg was traded in.

parameters.name: Underlying
parameters.description: Underlying symbol of the target leg.

parameters.name: Set Number
parameters.description: Set number of the target leg.

parameters.name: Condition Number
parameters.description: Condition number of the target leg.

parameters.name: Leg Number
parameters.description: Leg number of the target leg.

parameters.name: Activate At
parameters.description: Favorable move (points/%) from entry before the trailing stop arms.

parameters.name: Lock Profit At
parameters.description: Points/% behind price the stop trails at once armed.

parameters.name: Increase Profit By
parameters.description: Minimum further favorable move required before the stop is trailed again.

parameters.name: Increase TSL By
parameters.description: Amount the stop moves each time it re-trails. Single leg use only — do not use on legs that can re-enter (Rule 21).
